items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: he had a group and he wanted a piano player so they picked me and I went with him.

ctx.x: Wilbur Sweatman was a clarinet player. He used to play three clarinets at a time, see, and he had a group and he wanted a piano player so they picked me and I went with him. We traveled all over New England and then we come into New York in '21. The last part of '21, we came into New York and a fellow said Tom, I got a job for you, so I
went up to Larchmont, the Washington Arms. George Stevens, that was his name and he had the group. He was a singer. He used to be in the Shuffle Along show, he was a singer, good looking boy.
